newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair to market Sabena cargo.
newsitem.headline: Swissair to market Sabena cargo.

text.p: Swissair Cargo, Swissair AG's cargo division, said it would market the entire cargo capacity of Belgian carrier Sabena from January 1, 1997, strengthening its position as Europe's fifth largest cargo forwarder.
A Swissair statement said this would increase the carrier's cargo capacity by almost 25 percent to around two billion tonne-kms.
Swissair currently has a cargo capacity of 1.6 billion tkm and Sabena 350 million tmk.

"Swissair and Sabena sales units, now separate worldwide, will be reorganized into a single unit while sales and distribution activities will be combined," Swissair said, adding that details are still being worked out by joint teams.
A spokesman said the affect of the tighter collaboration on work forces was still not clear.a
